div.head: Cn 1020 8
div.ab: Nu bidde ic mine arcebiscopas ⁊ ealle mine leodbiscopas, þæt hy ealle neodfulle beon ymbe Godes gerihta, ælc on his ende, þe heom betæht is; ⁊ eac minum ealdormannum ic beode, þæt hy fylstan þam biscopum to Godes gerihtum ⁊ to minum kynescype ⁊ to ealles folces þearfe.

Nu bidde ic mine arcebiscopas ⁊ ealle mine leodbiscopas, þæt hy ealle neodfulle beon ymbe Godes gerihta, ælc on his ende þe heom betæht is; ⁊ eac minum ealdormannum ic beode, þæt hy fylstan þam biscopum to Godes gerihtum ⁊ to minum kynescype ⁊ to ealles folces þearfe.

[3] Nu bidde ic mine arcebiscopas and ealle mine leodbiscopas þæt hy ealle neodfulle beon ymbe Godes gerihta, ælc on his ende, þe him betæht is; and eac minum ealdormannum ic beode þæt hy fylstan þam biscopum to Godes gerihtum and to minum kynescype and to ealles folces þearfe.

Nun bitt ich meine Erzbischöfe und alle meine Suffragan-Bischöfe, dass sie alle sorgfältig seien betreffend die Gerechtsame der Kirche, jeder in seinem Bezirke, der ihm überwiesen ist; und ferner gebiet ich meinen Ealdormen, dass sie den Bischöfen zu den Gerechtsamen der Kirche verhelfen und zu meiner Königswürde und zum Nutzen des ganzen Volkes.

Now I ask my archbishops and all my diocesan bishops that they all be diligent about God's rights, each in the district entrusted to him; and further I command my ealdormen that they help the bishops in God's rights and in my royal dignity and for the benefit of all the people.

Now I pray my archbishops and all my diocesan bishops to be zealous with regard to the rights of the church—each one in the district which is entrusted to him; and likewise I enjoin upon my ealdormen to support the bishops in furthering the rights of the church and my royal authority and the well-being of the whole nation.

Now I pray my archbishops and all my diocesan bishops, that they all may be zealous about God’s dues, each in the district which is entrusted to him; and also I charge my ealdormen that they help the bishops in furthering God’s rights and my royal dignity and the benefit of all the people.

I now charge my archbishops and all my subordinate bishops to be conscientious concerning the rights of the Church, each in the region assigned to him; and I also command my ealdormen to support the bishops in advancing the rights of the Church and my royal authority and the welfare of the whole people.

note.seg: Cnut bittet Bischöfe, aber befiehlt Beamten; ebenso precipio et obtestor episcopos et praepositos, ut debita Deo sint persoluta; Cn 1027, 16
Cnut asks the bishops but commands the officials; likewise precipio et obtestor episcopos et praepositos, ut debita Deo sint persoluta; Cn 1027, 16
heom als dt. sg. s. Wb S. 111 Sp. 1
heom as dative singular, see Wb p. 111 col. 1
Vgl. Gl Ealdorman 8i. k. Wie mit eorl, o. 1 und im Breve Earle Landchar. 232, meint Cn das ganze Staatsbeamtentum
Cf. Gl Ealdorman 8i. k. As with eorl, above, 1, and in the writ Earle Landchar. 232, Cn means the whole body of state officials

Entweder ist ‘verhelfen’ nochmals ohne Dativ biscopum hinzuzudenken, oder wahrscheinlicher ‘⁊’ zu streichen und die zwei folgenden to ‘zugunsten, für’ zu verstehen; vgl. to cynescype ⁊ folce to þearfe I Cn Pro

Either 'verhelfen' ['help'] must be understood again, without the dative biscopum, or, more probably, '⁊' should be struck out and the two following to understood as 'in favour of, for'; cf. to cynescype ⁊ folce to þearfe I Cn Pro
